Build source-specific reporting support on a complete physical domain

Source: R/reporting_support.R
build_reporting_support.Rd

Preserves canonical polity footprints while selecting an explicit source/year inventory. Selected footprints must not overlap. The physical denominator is measured independently from the supplied domain, including territory with no selected reporting row. Neither source codes nor polity types set priority. Water supplied as whole-cell fractions is allocated uniformly over ice-free territory. This is an explicit within-cell spatial assumption, not an observed water-polygon distribution. Domain water beyond available ice-free territory remains recorded as excess. After geometric checks, a numerical excess within the existing polycell resolution (1e-6 ha per cell) is reduced proportionally. measured_land_area_ha, area_adjustment_ha and area_adjustment_method retain that operation; the independent domain is unchanged. Larger excesses abort, and genuinely unrepresented territory is never redistributed. These checks establish computational consistency, not historical boundary truth. Refs #1310, #1483 and #458.

Usage

build_reporting_support(inventory, domain, geometries = NULL, layers = list())

Arguments

inventory

Tibble with source, numeric whole year, and reporting_polity_code. Optional use is reporting or alternative; alternatives require a nonempty basis and remain in the returned inventory.

domain

An sf polygon table covering the complete physical domain, with a nonempty domain_source provenance column and year matching the inventory. Overlapping domain polygons are unioned, not summed. Completeness is a supplied contract, not inferred from reporting rows; the returned object preserves the domain for review.

geometries

Canonical polity geometries; defaults to get_polity_geometries().

layers

Named list with optional water and ice inputs as accepted by build_polycell_support(). Absent inputs remain stamped as absent.

Value

A reporting-support bundle with support, footprints, canonical_geometries, physical_domain, domain_support, inventory, domain, and per-cell audit. Use read_reporting_support() to retrieve support retaining the independent domain denominator.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) {
  g <- polycell_example_geometries()
  d <- sf::st_sf(domain_source = "example", year = 2010L,
                  geometry = sf::st_union(g))
  i <- tibble::tibble(source = "example", year = 2010L,
                     reporting_polity_code = g$polity_code)
  suppressWarnings(build_reporting_support(i, d, g))
}
